title: Saving a Part Library entry that was deleted in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GONE-01) has nothing behind it ("Total parts" 0).
  • The description you will type is {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL gone entry edited").
  • You can open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
custom_steps:
1. In browser tab 1, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  2. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. In tab 1, click the {Part-A} row.
  4. In tab 1, click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. In tab 1, replace the Description with {Description-A}.
  6. Do not click Save yet.
  7. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address and go to Parts → Part Library (tab 2).
  8. In tab 2, type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  9. In tab 2, click the {Part-A} row.
  10. In tab 2, click the edit icon.
  11. In tab 2, click Delete.
  12. In tab 2, confirm the deletion.
  13. Go back to tab 1.
  14. Do not reload tab 1.
  15. In tab 1, click Save.
  16. In tab 1, click Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu.
  17. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 12: In tab 2 the entry is deleted ("Library part deleted successfully.").
  • Step 15: The save is refused with a red error message that reads "Part Library entry not found." (with the smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."). Any heading the dialog shows for the failed save reads "Failed to save library part.", and no message uses the word "catalog" or "catalogue".
  • Step 17: No entry is listed for {Part-A}: the failed save did not create the entry again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S11-E4, S12-R4, S12-R5, S12-R11, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's 9 Oct answer (Chris Ward, question 8); QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 4. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E4: “If a Part Library entry is deleted while its detail page is open elsewhere, for example in another browser tab, saving that page is refused with "Part Library entry not found."”
  • S12-R4: “The failure message when saving a Part Library entry reads "Failed to save library part."”
  • S12-R5: “The success message when deleting a Part Library entry reads "Library part deleted successfully."”
  • S12-R11: “Refusals that name the shared list read: "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted.", "Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}.", "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}.", "Part Library entry missing category." and "A part from the Part Library must have Vendor as its source."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part Library entry missing): “"Part Library entry not found.", "Part Library entry not found for ID: {id}." or "Part Library entry not found for part number: {part number}." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (context note): “every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this."”
